common.deniedTitle: You do not have access to this page
common.deniedBody: Ask your hotel owner or manager if you need it.
common.notFoundBody: The page you asked for does not exist.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email and password your hotel administrator gave you.
login.noRecovery: Forgot your password? Ask your hotel owner or manager to reset it.

mfa.verifySubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.setupRequired: Your role can change money, staff or settings, so it needs a second step at sign-in.
mfa.setupStep1: Install an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator) on your phone.
mfa.setupStep2: Scan this code with the app, or type the key below.
mfa.setupStep3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app

overview.title: Welcome, {name}
overview.subtitle: {hotel}
overview.comingNext: Rooms, reservations, folios and accounting are being built in the next phases and will appear here when they are ready.
overview.noProperty: You have no property access yet. Ask your hotel owner to assign you a role.

staff.title: Staff & roles
staff.subtitle: Who can sign in, and what each person can do.
staff.name: Name
staff.initialPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. Give it to the person directly; they cannot reset it themselves yet.
staff.disableBody: They will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until enabled again.
staff.enableBody: They will be able to sign in again with their existing password.
staff.resetMfaBody: Use this when they lose their phone. They are signed out and must set up two-step verification again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Sign-ins, staff changes and settings changes. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

property.title: Property settings
property.subtitle: Details printed on documents and used for dates and times.
property.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
property.name: Property name
property.currencyNote: Fixed at setup. Every amount stores its own currency.
property.businessDateNote: Advances only when the daily close runs.

account.title: My account
account.mfaOff: Two-step verification is off. Turning it on protects your account if your password is stolen.
account.lostPhone: Lost your phone? Ask your hotel owner to reset two-step verification for you.

onboarding.title: Set up {property}
onboarding.subtitle: A few details so documents, dates and times are right. You can stop at any point and continue later.
onboarding.reviewIntro: Check these details. You can change them later in Property settings.
onboarding.inProgressBody: {property} is still being set up by your hotel owner or manager. Check back once setup is complete.
onboarding.roomsIntro: Add your room types with a nightly rate, then the rooms of each type. You need at least one room to finish.
onboarding.roomsNotReady: Add at least one room, and a rate for every room type that has rooms.

rooms.title: Rooms & rates
rooms.subtitle: Room types, their nightly rates, and the rooms of each type.
rooms.readOnly: You can view rooms and rates but not change them.
rooms.codeHint: Short code shown on the board, e.g. DLX.
rooms.name: Name
rooms.capacityValue: {adults, plural, one {# adult} other {# adults}}, {children, plural, one {# child} other {# children}}
rooms.rateHint: Before tax rules are set up. Optional now; required before finishing setup.
rooms.ratesIntro: Rates apply from their start date until the next one. Bookings keep the rate agreed when they were made.
rooms.noTypes: No room types yet. Add one to start.
rooms.preview: Will add {count, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}}: {list}
rooms.deactivateTypeBlocked: Deactivate or move its rooms first.

board.title: Room board
board.subtitle: Status of every room on {date}.
board.noRooms: No rooms have been set up yet.

guests.title: Guests
guests.subtitle: Search by name, phone or email.
guests.marketingConsent: Agrees to receive offers and news
guests.duplicatesHint: Open the existing profile instead of creating a second one, unless this is a different person.
guests.documentsHidden: {count, plural, =0 {No documents on file.} one {# document on file. You do not have access to identity documents.} other {# documents on file. You do not have access to identity documents.}}
guests.removeBody: The document is deleted; the removal is recorded in the audit log.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.noRooms: No rooms are set up yet.
reservations.calendarHint: Select an empty night to start a booking for that room.
reservations.guestsLine: {adults, plural, one {# adult} other {# adults}}, {children, plural, one {# child} other {# children}}
reservations.cancelBody: The rooms become available again. The reason is kept in the history.
reservations.noShowBody: Use this when the guest did not arrive. The rooms become available again.

frontDesk.title: Front desk
frontDesk.subtitle: Today, {date}
frontDesk.checkoutLater: Check-out becomes available once guest billing is in place.
frontDesk.notReadyNoOverride: Choose a ready room, or ask a manager.
frontDesk.noRoomsFree: No room is free for these dates.

housekeeping.title: Housekeeping
housekeeping.subtitle: Cleaning and inspection work for {date}.

maintenance.takeOut: Take the room out of order
maintenance.toHint: Leave empty to keep it out of order until the problem is resolved.

maintenance.unassigned: Bookings that need a new room:

dayClose.title: Day close
dayClose.subtitle: Close {date} and move the hotel to {next}.
dayClose.interimNote: Operational close only. Room charges are not posted yet; that arrives with guest billing.
dayClose.allClear: Nothing is open. The day can be closed.

checkLabels.arrivals_pending: Guests due who have not checked in
checkLabels.overstays: Guests still in house after their departure date

dayClose.markNoShows: Mark the {count, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}} still due as no-shows
dayClose.reason: Reason for closing with open items (recorded)
dayClose.closed: {date} closed. The business date is now {next}.

finance.accountingDateHint: Not later than the business date.
finance.referenceHint: Optional, e.g. a bill or voucher number.
finance.unbalancedNote: You can save an unbalanced draft. Posting needs debits and credits to be equal.
finance.journalsSubtitle: Every posting in the general ledger. Posted entries never change; corrections are reversals.
finance.newJournalSubtitle: A manual entry, such as an opening balance or a correction.
finance.postFailed: The draft was saved but not posted. Fix the problem shown, then post it.
finance.notManualNote: This entry was created by another record. Correct it from that record.
finance.reverseExplain: A new entry with the same amounts on the opposite sides will be posted. The original stays in the ledger, marked reversed.
finance.deleteDraftExplain: Drafts are not in the ledger. Deleting one cannot be undone.
finance.accountsSubtitle: Accounts are never deleted. System accounts are used by the posting rules and always stay active.
finance.accountCodeHint: 4 to 6 digits starting with {digit}. Cannot be changed later.
finance.activeLabel: Active (inactive accounts cannot be posted to)
finance.tbSubtitle: Opening, movement and closing balance of every account, from posted entries only.
finance.rangeError: The end date must not be before the start date.
finance.tbNotBalanced: Debits and credits do not agree. Contact support with this date range.
finance.tbEmpty: No postings up to this date.
finance.tbNote: Balances are cumulative from the first posting. Year-end closing arrives with the accounting phase.
finance.ledgerSubtitle: Every posted line on one account, with a running balance.
finance.ledgerPick: Choose an account to see its ledger.
finance.periodsSubtitle: Closing a month stops any posting into it. Reopening needs a reason and is recorded.
finance.periodCounts: {posted, plural, one {# posted entry} other {# posted entries}}, {drafts, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}}
finance.closeExplain: Nothing can be posted into this month while it is closed. Drafts dated in it can still be edited.
finance.reopenExplain: Postings into this month will be allowed again. Your reason is kept in the audit log.
